name: Belagavi Fort & Kamal Basti
description: Historic 12th-century stone fortress housing the intricately carved Jain Kamal Basti temple.
shortDescription: Explore a stone fort and the detailed Jain Kamal Basti temple.

name: Purohit Sweets & Authentic Kunda
description: Iconic sweet house celebrated for traditional slow-cooked Belagavi Kunda and fresh milk desserts.
shortDescription: Taste Belagavi's signature slow-cooked Kunda and milk sweets.

name: Gokak Falls Adventure Walk
description: Suspension bridge walk and scenic gorge trekking overlooking the cascading Ghataprabha river falls.
shortDescription: Walk the suspension bridge above the Ghataprabha gorge.

name: Khasbag Handloom Cooperative
description: Master weavers producing prized traditional Belagavi silk and fine cotton handloom sarees.
shortDescription: See traditional Belagavi silk and cotton handloom work.

name: The Camp Artisan Roastery
description: Cozy specialty cafe serving single-origin pour-overs, Belgian waffles, and artisanal light bites.
shortDescription: Settle in for specialty coffee, waffles, and light bites.

name: Jamboti Forest Eco Trails
description: Guided rainforest trek through lush Western Ghats woodlands with clear freshwater stream crossings.
shortDescription: Follow forest trails and freshwater streams in the Western Ghats.

name: Sanjivani Ayurvedic Wellness Retreat
description: Authentic healing sanctuary specializing in rejuvenating herbal therapies, Panchakarma, and meditation.
shortDescription: Unwind with traditional therapies and guided meditation.

name: Niyaz Restaurant
description: Beloved culinary landmark acclaimed for authentic Belagavi mutton biryani and tandoori specialties.
shortDescription: Try local biryani and tandoori favorites at this city landmark.

name: Rajhans Gad Yellur Fort
description: Hilltop fortress rewarding hikers with panoramic vistas of rural Belagavi's fertile green valleys.
shortDescription: Climb to an old hill fort and wide valley views.

name: Kittur Fort & Chennamma Museum
description: Historic palace ramparts and heritage museum preserving artifacts of queen Rani Chennamma's rebellion.
shortDescription: Discover the fort, palace walls, and Chennamma-era history.

name: Cafe Canvas & Art Studio
description: Creative studio space blending regional art exhibits, barista coffee, and fresh Continental bites.
shortDescription: Pair regional art exhibits with coffee and a light meal.

name: Shahapur Clay Craft Studio
description: Hands-on terracotta pottery workshop offering clay sculpting experiences and artisanal earthenware.
shortDescription: Shape clay and browse locally made terracotta pieces.

name: Hidkal Reservoir & Boating Club
description: Serene lakeside reserve featuring peaceful boat excursions, migratory birding, and sunset viewpoints.
shortDescription: Take a quiet boat ride and look for birds by the water.

name: Highland Bistro & Live Lounge
description: Energetic rooftop gathering spot with craft mocktails, woodfired pizzas, and weekend acoustic gigs.
shortDescription: Share wood-fired pizza and mocktails with rooftop views.

name: Suvarna Vidhana Soudha Gardens
description: Manicured public botanical grounds surrounding the monumental state legislature architecture.
shortDescription: Take a quiet garden walk beside Belagavi's landmark legislature building.

name: Nisarga Yoga & Herbal Haven
description: Tranquil farm-side wellness retreat offering dawn yoga sessions, herbal steam, and satvik cuisine.
shortDescription: Find a slower pace with yoga, herbal steam, and a farm-side setting.

name: Asha Mandige House
description: Century-old culinary establishment hand-stretching delicate crepelike Mandige over earthen pots.
shortDescription: Try Belagavi's delicate, hand-stretched traditional Mandige.

name: Camp Heritage Brassware Emporium
description: Heritage antique gallery presenting handcrafted bell-metal artifacts, lamps, and wood carvings.
shortDescription: Browse handcrafted brassware and heritage pieces in Camp.

name: Vajrapoha Falls Jungle Expedition
description: Challenging wilderness expedition heading into the deep Mahadayi wildlife sanctuary cascades.
shortDescription: Venture toward remote cascades in the Mahadayi sanctuary.

name: Root & Stone Organic Cafe
description: Mindful farm-to-table cafe preparing cold-pressed botanicals, vegan bowls, and millet sourdough.
shortDescription: Choose a fresh plant-based meal made with local ingredients.
